title: RDW (Red Cell Distribution Width)
attribution: Source: MedlinePlus, National Library of Medicine.
measures: RDW describes how much the red blood cells vary in size and volume. It is normal when the cells are close to the same size.
low: MedlinePlus does not list causes for a low RDW on this page.
high: MedlinePlus does not list specific causes for a high RDW on this page; it says only that an unusual result indicates differences in size among the red blood cells.
notes: An RDW result alone is not enough for a diagnosis. It is read with the other red cell indices and blood tests, and unusual indices may suggest anemia.
